Great — thanks for the trust. I can do this, but I need one quick confirmation and a few small details before I send or create any calendar entries (calendar/email actions are externally visible and I need your OK on specifics).

Below is a polished invitation I propose. Review and tell me any edits, then confirm how you want me to proceed.

Proposed email invitation
Subject: Invitation — Customer Advisory Board (CAB) — [Proposed Date]

Hi [Name],

I’d like to invite you to our next Customer Advisory Board meeting. The CAB is a small group of customers who help shape our product roadmap and provide strategic feedback.

Details
- Date: [Proposed Date — e.g., Wednesday, June 24]
- Time: [Proposed Time & Time Zone — e.g., 10:00–11:00 AM PT]
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Location: [Virtual — Zoom/Teams link to follow] or [In-person at [location]]
- Purpose: Share product roadmap updates, discuss top customer priorities, and gather guidance on upcoming features.

Proposed agenda (60 minutes)
1. Welcome & objectives (5 min)
2. Product roadmap highlights + demo (20 min)
3. Customer priorities & feedback session (25 min)
4. Next steps & close (10 min)

RSVP and prep
- Please RSVP by [RSVP date, e.g., one week before].
- If you’d like to propose topics, please reply with up to two items you'd like discussed.

Thanks so much for your time — we greatly value your input.
Best,
[Your name / Title / Company]
[Contact info]

Questions I need you to confirm (or I can decide if you want me to pick)
1. Do you want me to (A) send this email now to a specific attendee list you provide, (B) pick 2–3 date/time options and send a scheduling poll, or (C) create a calendar event immediately and invite attendees? (Pick A, B, or C.)
2. Who should be invited? (Provide the attendee list or tell me a group alias.)
3. Preferred date(s)/time(s) or timezone? If you want me to pick, say “pick for me” and I’ll propose two slots next month in your recipients’ time zone (default: 60-minute meeting, mid-week mornings).
4. Virtual conferencing: do you want me to include a Zoom/Teams link (I can add a placeholder and note that conferencing details will follow) or leave location blank for now?
5. Any changes to the draft (subject line, agenda items, tone, attachments to include)?
6. Do you want me to send the invite from your address or draft it for you to send? (I can create the calendar event if you confirm the details.)

If you reply “go ahead” and provide attendee list and preferred approach (A, B, or C) I will:
- Finalize the invite text with any edits you request.
- Create/send the calendar invitation or scheduling poll (only after you confirm which action you want and give the attendee list/timezone).

What would you like me to do now?
